limits.statistics: descriptive only; n is 3 rounds per boot and direction
limits.no_pooling: boots and directions are reported separately and never pooled

plan.note: the whole stored plan document must equal the plan regenerated from the frozen selection and seed, including count, counts, phases, boots and every case; only the plan_sha256 field is excluded from the comparison

companions.note: selection.sha256 and plan.sha256 are required and verified strictly against the raw and canonical file content

runs.note: every directory under runs/ must belong to a frozen case id

selection.note: the frozen selection is copied verbatim at freeze time; no new calibration is performed and no unmatched selection is turned into a gain

match_rule.note: paired same-round V median within 5%, both sides reach 170, per-run E23/E20 deficit difference <= 10 points, every paired run has complete_active_windows > 0; 5% A gain is engineering only

boots.note: 第一次复用已有启动，第二次新启动；有既往462项活动，不能当成两次全新启动

notes: capability/role register matches alone never establish a mechanism
the run is the sample unit; 3 rounds per boot and direction are engineering repetition only
boots and directions are never pooled; the two boots are reported separately
an unmatched protection match or a missing pairing never supports a gain claim
raw 0xE25 is permission_closed_cycles, never an ADMIT stall and never a divisor
V uses raw 0xC12 and A uses p4m.window[3] over the same common window raw 0xC19
failed, missing and nonzero-exit cases are preserved and never retried
